# The Apostolic Church – Ghana | Central Region Zone 1 Youth Camp 2026

> Official website for the 2026 Youth & Children's Camp Meeting ("Run To Win!").

## About the Event
- Host Organization: The Apostolic Church – Ghana, National Youth Ministry (TAC-NGYN) in collaboration with Children Ministry.
- Participating Areas: Central Region Zone 1 (Agona Swedru Area and Winneba-Apam Area).
- Theme: "Run To Win!" (1 Corinthians 9:24–26).
- Dates: Thursday, September 3, 2026 – Sunday, September 6, 2026.
- Venue: Swedru School of Business (SWESBUS), Agona Swedru, Central Region, Ghana.
- Registration Fees: Regular Youth Camper: GHc 200.00 | Under 13 Years: GHc 150.00 | Non-Residential: GHc 120.00.

## Site Pages
- Home & Live Hub (https://tacyouthcamp.org/): Live program updates, schedule reveal engine, countdown, and camp announcements.
- Camp Schedule (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/schedule.html): Full 4-day timetable...
- Action Groups (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/action-groups.html): Complete breakout study curriculum: Study 1, Study 2, and Study 3 with memory verses and discussions. Full 4-day timetable, hostel routine, daily order of services, and dress code guidelines.
- Camp Activities & Outreach (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/activities.html): Outreach at Oteipirow, Career Symposium, Inter-district sports, and Bonfire night.
- Pastoral Messages & Studies (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/messages.html): Official welcome message from Ps. Enoch Bortey Offei, Superintendent Aps. Andrews Nortey's charge, Apostle W.S. Dantiar retirement tribute, and Bible Study Outlines 1, 2, and 3.
- Leadership Directory (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/about.html): Leadership directory and theme vision.
- Venue & Registration (https://tacyouthcamp.org/pages/contact.html): Venue travel directions, registration secretariat info, packing checklist, and contact form.
